compiled_state.title: write-cycle-ledger.sh missing input validation — test-write-cycle-ledger.sh has 8 RED failures on main (path-traversal, non-integer PR, duplicate cycle_num)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Reproduction

\`\`\`bash
bash tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh
\`\`\`

## Expected

All assertions pass.

## Actual (on main HEAD 5ec73dd1cf and on PR #214 recovery branch)

PASSED: 30  FAILED: 8

Failures:
- path-traversal findings_hash rejected exit (expected: 1, actual: 0)
- path-traversal findings_hash stderr (expected to contain: findings-hash, actual: empty)
- path-traversal epic_id rejected exit (expected: 1, actual: 0)
- path-traversal epic_id stderr (expected to contain: epic-id, actual: empty)
- non-integer DSO_CI_REVIEW_PR rejected exit (expected: 1, actual: 0)
- non-integer PR stderr (expected to contain: DSO_CI_REVIEW_PR, actual: empty)
- duplicate cycle_num rejected exit (expected: 1, actual: 0)
- duplicate cycle_num stderr (expected to contain: already exists, actual: empty)

## Root cause (inferred)

\`plugins/dso/scripts/write-cycle-ledger.sh\` lacks input validation for:
1. Path-traversal-safe \`--findings-hash\` and \`--epic-id\` (reject \`/etc/passwd\`, \`../foo\`, etc.)
2. Integer check for \`DSO_CI_REVIEW_PR\` env var
3. Duplicate-cycle-num guard (refuse to overwrite existing cycle entry)

The test file (\`tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh:6\`) carries a comment indicating these are RED tests for unwritten validation logic. Implementing tasks 15dc-related guards should resolve.

## Impact

Pre-existing on main; CI \"Script Tests\" job fails on every PR and on main pushes. Surfaced by PR #214 (62c9 recovery) — failure is NOT caused by that PR (recovery touches only arbiter files).

## Scope

Out of scope for PR #214. Should be addressed as a focused fix on its own branch.
